第476章 将来的打算（第1页）
皇甫皓轩的这段话，哄得蓝若晴开心的，“咯咯”的笑了起来。
“真的没有想到，当今的太子也会说这么好听的情话！”蓝若晴取笑着皇甫皓轩。
“我的情话，只会说给你一个人听。而且，我已经与父皇说了，让他撤除我太子的头衔，封亦轩为太子。”
“是真的！我的奏折已经递了上去。相信明天就会有消息，或者，父皇现在看到了，已经在做打算。”
蓝若晴垂下眼帘，感动的问道：“皓轩，你真的觉得，为了我放弃皇位是值得的吗？”
“是的！对我来说，这是我一生之中做的最正确的一件事！”
“你就不怕亦轩将来也会像历代的皇子一样，怕你回来抢皇位，四处追杀你吗？”
“我不怕！我与亦轩的感情，是你想象不到的！而且我相信他！”
“那你就这样子为了我，放弃一切，你觉得值吗？”
“是的！我觉得很值！今生能与你在一起，是最快乐的事！”
蓝若晴终于隐忍不住的，伏在皇甫皓轩的怀里。
这个时候，她已经不在意是否会有人看到，也不在意是否会有人说道。
她只想让自己的身心都投入到这个为她放弃一切的男子的怀里，走进他的心里。
“若晴，天气越来越暖了，我们计划一下，去哪里！”
“现在吗？”蓝若晴抬起头，疑惑的看着皇甫皓轩。
“是的！现在！我真的是迫不及待的想与你出去走走，看看。”
“可是……我觉得现在还有很多的事情没有完成。我总要等到小溪与表哥结婚，汐冷生下孩子……”

“然后就等着映雪与莹雪也生了孩子，你再等小溪生孩子吗？若晴，她们现在都有自己的生活了，你总要顾及一下我的感受？”
“蓝汐冷的产期不到两个月的时间了，小溪与表哥的婚礼我答应了小溪一定要参加的。皓轩，你是知道的，蓝汐冷是什么手段都会用的人。就在今天，她找胡太医给她开了落胎的药。还好被发现的早，否则的话，后果是不堪设想的，肯定会一尸两命的！”
“蓝汐冷的小把戏，虽然不是我们所预料的，但是还在控制的范围之内。”
“什么意思？你们早就知道她会怎样做？”
“我与亦轩早就防备过她，只是没有想到她会用如此过激的方法来吸引亦轩的注意力，这倒是我们没有想到的。不过之前我与亦轩有商议过，该怎样对付她，不要你来操心。”
“那怎么可以？我好怕亦轩会被她迷惑！今天我就看到她楚楚可怜的样子，让亦轩对她动心。可是趴在亦轩肩头上的她，那狠毒的目光是亦轩看不到的！在亦轩的身后做小动作，让亦轩防不可防，那真的是很危险的！我不能看着亦轩被她伤害！”
“会吗？我觉得亦轩是个很有自制力的人，他真的会被蓝汐冷所迷惑吗？”
“只怕蓝汐冷的小手段，并不会少。所以还是防着些的好。”
“你说的有道理，我们找亦轩好好的商量一下。”

Chapter 476 Future Plans (Page 1)
Huangfu Haoxuan's words made Lan Ruoqing happy and giggle.
"I really didn't expect that today's prince would say such nice love words!" Lan Ruoqing teased Huangfu Haoxuan.
"My love words will only be told to you. Moreover, I have already told my father to remove my title of crown prince and make Yixuan the crown prince."
"It's true! My memorial has been handed in. I believe there will be news tomorrow, or maybe my father has seen it now and is already making plans."
Lan Ruoqing lowered her eyes and asked movedly: "Haoxuan, do you really think it's worth giving up the throne for me?"
"Yes! For me, this is the most correct thing I have done in my life!"
"Aren't you afraid that Yixuan will be like the princes of all generations in the future, afraid that you will come back to seize the throne and hunt you down everywhere?"
"I'm not afraid! My relationship with Yixuan is beyond your imagination! And I believe in him!"
"Then you just give up everything for me. Do you think it's worth it?"
"Yes! I think it's worth it! Being with you in this life is the happiest thing!"
Lan Ruoqing finally couldn't bear it anymore and lay in Huangfu Haoxuan's arms.
At this time, she no longer cared whether anyone would see or say anything.
She just wanted to put her body and mind into the arms of this man who gave up everything for her, and walk into his heart.
"If it's sunny, the weather is getting warmer. Let's plan where to go!"
"Now?" Lan Ruoqing raised her head and looked at Huangfu Haoxuan doubtfully.
"Yes! Now! I really can't wait to go out and see you."
"But... I feel that there are still many things that have not been completed. I always have to wait until Xiaoxi gets married to my cousin and tide Leng gives birth to a child..."
"Then you wait until Yingxue and Yingxue have a baby. Are you going to wait for Xiaoxi to have a baby? Ruoqing, they all have their own lives now. You always have to take my feelings into consideration?"
"Lan Xi Leng's delivery date is less than two months away. I promised Xiao Xi that I would attend the wedding between Xiao Xi and my cousin. Haoxuan, you know that Lan Xi Leng is a person who can use any means. Just today, she asked Dr. Hu to prescribe her the medicine to abort the baby. Fortunately, she was discovered early, otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable, and one person and two people would definitely die!"
"Lan Xileng's little trick is not what we expected, but it is still within the control range."
"What do you mean? You already knew what she would do?"
"Yixuan and I have been on guard against her for a long time, but we didn't expect that she would use such an extreme method to attract Yixuan's attention. This is something we didn't expect. However, Yixuan and I have discussed how to deal with her before, and I don't want you to worry about it."
"How is that possible? I'm so afraid that Yixuan will be confused by her! Today I saw her pitiful look, which made Yixuan fall in love with her. But Yixuan can't see her vicious gaze when she is lying on Yixuan's shoulder! Making small moves behind Yixuan makes Yixuan defenseless. That is really dangerous! I can't watch Yixuan get hurt by her!"
"Is that so? I think Yixuan is a very self-controlled person. Will he really be confused by Lan Xileng?"
"I'm afraid Lan tide Leng has a lot of tricks up his sleeve. So it's better to be on guard."
"What you said makes sense. Let's discuss it carefully with Yixuan."
